verdict.rationale: Figma publishes a REST API changelog documenting endpoint additions/renames (e.g., v2 folders endpoints, projects→folders rename) and an OpenAPI spec repo, showing some versioning practice, but there is no explicit documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, migration guarantees) for the REST API or MCP server. missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy statement, version support timelines, sunset/EOL notices for old endpoints.
